items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: And, but they had a couple of men in that, that, that could play jazz, like Steve.

ctx.x: Yeah. And, and, and it had this, this, this canal. I don't know, I think it's, it, leads into Bayer St. John. Yeah, I think that is Bayer St. John. It, it, it, it is part of Bayer St. John. I think it is. Anyway, they used to call it Over the Rhine. Well, they had this restaurant over there, where the society people used to go to eat. It was a very famous place. But that, that wasn't a jazz band at all. You see, they, they, they, they read everything. The P-Rock. Yeah, the P-Rock band. It wasn't a jazz band. They…
And, uh, you remember Tee-go on Clarenet.
